subject: Request: Oxbridge AI customer spotlight + logo permission
messages:
From: Olivia Park <olivia.park@oxbridge.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Legal - Oxbridge <legal@oxbridge.ai>, Laura Miles <laura@northshorepr.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Oxbridge AI customer spotlight + logo permission

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for reaching out — were excited about the pilot results and happy to help with a short customer spotlight. A few quick asks from our side before we proceed: can we review a one-page draft and the exact logo assets you plan to use? Our legal team needs to confirm acceptable quote language and that the logo is used in accordance with our brand rules.

I've looped in our legal contact and our PR agency to keep things moving. If you can send the mockup and a simple permission form we can route internally.

Attachments: none on my side.

Best,
Olivia Park
Head of Communications, Oxbridge AI
olivia.park@oxbridge.ai
+1 415-555-0182

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Park <olivia.park@oxbridge.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 10:32:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Oxbridge AI customer spotlight + logo permission

Hi Olivia — great, thanks for the quick reply. Attached is a one-page mockup (redwood_case_study_mockup_v1.pdf) that includes the proposed headline, a short excerpt of the pilot results, and the callout quote we'd like to pull from your team. I've also attached a zip with the logo variants we plan to use.

Quick notes:
- The quote is attributed to Dr. A. Singh (Product Lead) and is based on the API latency improvements in the pilot. If you prefer a different attribution or wording please suggest edits.
- We've prepared a short permission form that covers logo usage, byline, and timing. I can send via DocuSign once legal is comfortable with the mockup.

Attachments: [redwood_case_study_mockup_v1.pdf (pdf)], [oxbridge_logo_pack.zip (zip)], [permission_form_draft.docx (docx - draft)]

Proposed next step: legal review + sign the attached permission form. If thats fine I'll move this to DocuSign and we can aim to publish a short spotlight on the Redwood blog and include a 1-paragraph customer quote in our press outreach.

Thanks — Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0199
redwood.com

From: Legal - Oxbridge <legal@oxbridge.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Olivia Park <olivia.park@oxbridge.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 14:10:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Oxbridge AI customer spotlight + logo permission

Vanessa / Olivia — attaching a signed permission form and a couple of small redlines we applied to the quote attribution. The edits are limited to: clarifying that the quote reflects Oxbridge's view of the pilot results, and adding a standard non-endorsement clause (we are happy to be featured, but wording must avoid implying an explicit product endorsement beyond the described pilot).

Attached: signed_permission_form.pdf (pdf), oxbridge_redlines.pdf (pdf)

Please incorporate the updated quote language in the mockup and resend for a final look. Once the mockup reflects the redlines we confirm the logos are fine to publish under the terms in the signed PDF.

Best regards,
Maya R. (on behalf of Oxbridge Legal)
legal@oxbridge.ai
